name: bws-notify
description: Windows toasts that say which project and what happened: permission asks, finished turns, finished subagents and errors, with the reply's first line. Replaces the modal MessageBox hook.

needsInput.title: Toast when Claude needs you
needsInput.description: Permission asks, questions and idle prompts, with the text Claude is waiting on.

turnDone.title: Toast when a turn finishes
turnDone.description: Claude stopped. The toast carries the first line of its last reply.

minTurnSeconds.title: Turn toast: minimum length (seconds)
minTurnSeconds.description: Skip the finished-turn toast for turns shorter than this.

subagentDone.title: Toast when a subagent finishes
subagentDone.description: Subagent type and the first line of its report.

errors.title: Toast on errors
errors.description: The turn ended on an API error (limit, overload, auth).

maxBodyChars.title: Toast body length
maxBodyChars.description: Characters of the reply or prompt text kept in a toast.
